name: opensees_centrifuge
disabled_reason: Strut and OpenSees now both complete both gravity stages and the capped 0.15 seconds of shaking. At the first shaking sample, node 1 horizontal displacement is about -2.637e-4 in Strut and -1.749e-4 in OpenSees, outside the normal tolerance.
reference: Antonios Vytiniotis, Simulating a Centrifuge Test using the OpenSees Framework, OpenSees User Manual, chapter 4188.
notes: Both gravity stages and the first 0.15 seconds of the original adaptive shaking sequence.
